highlights.caseName: Mulla Afroz v. Union of India
highlights.text: A custodial confession alone can't justify NSA detention; Rs 10 lakh costs on UP.

highlights.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Bhupesh Arora
highlights.text: Bail cancelled in Chinese app PMLA case: settling the fraud doesn't erase laundering.
Hookah bars barred across UP, even in designated smoking areas.

highlights.caseName: Kerala Police Association v. State of Kerala
highlights.text: Order abolishing a police officers' association breached Article 19(1)(c).

highlights.caseName: Vipin Pandey v. Rani Durgavati University
highlights.text: Bar Council must frame a minimum stipend for junior advocates.

items.caseName: Mulla Afroz v. Union of India
items.headline: NSA detention of Sambhal violence accused quashed; Rs 10 lakh costs on UP
items.text: A confession made in police custody cannot by itself support preventive detention. The NSA order was quashed with Rs 10 lakh costs on UP.
items.why: Protects the Article 22(5) safeguard against detention built on custodial statements.

items.caseName: S v. State of Odisha
items.headline: Marriage at a 'dead end' dissolved under Article 142
items.text: The Court granted divorce with Rs 35 lakh permanent alimony. It quashed 18 cases between the couple and barred fresh litigation.

items.caseName: M/s ASJ Finsolutions Pvt. Ltd. v. Vikram Bajaj
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: EMD forfeited when auction terms allow it, even if IBBI rules are silent
items.text: A bidder who missed paying the Rs 19.17 crore balance lost its Rs 6.39 crore deposit. Express e-auction forfeiture terms were enforceable.

items.caseName: Bombay Garage Ahmedabad Ltd. v. J P Iscon Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Omitted relief stays barred despite liberty to file a fresh suit
items.text: Without leave under Order 2 Rule 2 CPC in the first suit, a later suit for specific performance is barred. Liberty under Order 23 does not cure this.

items.caseName: Megha Gaur v. State of Rajasthan
items.coram: CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: RCA polls go ahead, but results kept sealed
items.text: The Court refused to halt the Rajasthan Cricket Association elections but barred declaring results. The HC must quickly hear the plea on excluding women voters.

items.caseName: Dinesh Biwaji Ashtikar v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: NCPCR chief summoned over 25% RTE quota
items.text: Faulting NCPCR's indifference to the EWS quota in private schools, the bench directed its Chairperson and Director to appear in person.

items.caseName: Sahadev Uraon v. State of Jharkhand
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: Bail for man jailed over posts on Kalpana Soren
items.text: After over a year in custody, with the chargesheet filed and a maximum sentence of three years, the accused was granted bail.

items.caseName: Gunjan Sinha v. Union of India
items.headline: Should patent term run from grant when grant is delayed?
items.text: Notice issued on a plea that a seven-year grant delay ate into the 20-year patent term under Section 53. An amicus will assist.

items.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Bhupesh Arora
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: Bail cancelled in Chinese investment app PMLA case
items.text: Settling the predicate offence does not wipe out the money laundering. Arora's bail was cancelled and co-accused Rohit Vij's plea rejected.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, JJ.
items.headline: No hookah bars in UP, even in smoking zones
items.text: Hookah service is barred even in designated smoking areas. A non-smoker's right to clean air outweighs the right to trade.

items.caseName: Nirmala Devi v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Heart attack claim can't end dowry death case at the outset
items.text: Where a young wife dies within seven years amid cruelty claims, a heart attack finding does not prove a natural death at the quashing stage.

items.caseName: West Bengal Pradesh Congress Committee v. Election Commission of India
items.headline: Plea on BJP Nandigram candidate's age discrepancy dismissed
items.text: The Court rejected Congress's challenge to Hasirani Rath's affidavit, accepting that the objection was late and did not affect her eligibility.

items.caseName: Milan Pradhan v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Interim bail lets Congress candidate contest Nandigram by-poll
items.text: Pradhan was released on interim bail till 20 October. Warrants from 2007 were executed only after he filed his nomination.

items.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Greenopolis Welfare Confederation
items.headline: Ex-CJI Sanjiv Khanna to head Greenopolis homebuyers' panel
items.text: A committee will verify homebuyers' claims over ED-attached properties in the stalled Gurugram project and help restitution within eight months.

items.caseName: Red Bull v. Union of India
items.headline: FSSAI order against 'Energy Drink' label set aside
items.text: Red Bull was not heard before the order was passed. FSSAI may reconsider after giving a proper hearing.

items.caseName: Harcharan Singh Bhalla v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: No custodial interrogation just to recover stridhan
items.text: Recovering stridhan is outside the bail court's remit, so it cannot justify custody. An 80-year-old was granted anticipatory bail.

items.caseName: South Indian Bank Ltd. v. National Highways Authority of India
items.headline: Rs 1 lakh costs on lawyer who appeared from a moving car
items.text: Joining a virtual hearing from a moving vehicle breached the video-conferencing rules, so costs were imposed on counsel.

items.caseName: Arvind Kejriwal v. Gujarat University
items.coram: CJ Sunita Agarwal, D.N. Ray, J.
items.headline: Kejriwal's appeal against Rs 25,000 costs in PM degree row rejected
items.text: The Division Bench refused to disturb the costs imposed over his RTI pursuit of the Prime Minister's degree.

items.caseName: State of Gujarat v. Rasikbhai @ Kaushikbhai Havsingbhai Garasiya
items.coram: Ilesh J. Vora, R.T. Vachhani, JJ.
items.headline: DNA report inadmissible unless the expert testifies
items.text: The acquittal in a rape case was upheld. The DNA report could not be relied on as the scientist who ran the test was not examined.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Mohsin Sharieff
items.coram: D.K. Singh, H. Shanthi Bhushan, JJ.
items.headline: 3 acres of Yelahanka defence land restored to IAF
items.text: The Military Land Register is conclusive proof of title. A private claim based on a 2015 sale deed failed.

items.caseName: Santhosh Kumar H.L. v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Blow to pregnant woman's abdomen can be attempt to murder
items.text: No visible injury and a healthy delivery do not take such an assault outside Section 307 IPC. The plea to quash was rejected.

items.caseName: Juhi v. Union of India
items.headline: No OBC reservation within NRI quota seats
items.text: NRI quota is separate and unreserved, so a NEET-UG candidate cannot claim both NRI and OBC benefits.

items.caseName: Chandan G v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Rs 2.77 crore for man paralysed by falling tree branch
items.text: BBMP was held liable for a dangerous tree on school land beside a public road and must pay compensation with 6% interest.

items.caseName: X v. Rajesh
items.caseNo: Rev. Pet. Family Court No. 100065 of 2025
items.headline: Master's degree no bar to wife's maintenance
items.text: Denial of permanent alimony earlier does not defeat a Section 125 CrPC claim. The husband must pay Rs 5,000 a month each to wife and child.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.coram: M.I. Arun, Raghavendra Seetharam Srivatsa, JJ.
items.headline: No Section 65B certificate needed in family courts
items.text: Section 14 of the Family Courts Act overrides the Evidence Act, so electronic evidence can be accepted without a 65B certificate.

items.caseName: Kerala Police Association v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Order abolishing police officers' association quashed
items.text: The order restructuring police associations breached Article 19(1)(c) and was passed without consulting members.

items.caseName: Vipin Pandey v. Rani Durgavati University
items.headline: Bar Council told to frame minimum stipend for juniors
items.text: Guidelines are due within six months. The Court suggested Rs 20,000 a month in cities and Rs 15,000 in rural areas for three years.

items.caseName: Dr. Pushyamitra Mishra v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.headline: 'An FIR is not an encyclopedia'
items.text: Not spelling out each accused's role is no ground to quash. Disputed facts must go to trial.

items.caseName: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India v. G. Subramania Koushik
items.coram: N. Satish Kumar, Bharatha Chakravarthy, JJ.
items.headline: Micro/nano plastic warning labels stay
items.text: FSSAI's review of the order for warnings on water, salt and sugar packs was rejected. Consumers have a right to know.

items.caseName: S. Kasiramalingam v. Election Commission of India
items.coram: CJ S.A. Dharmadhikari, G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: 'Publicity' PIL on resigned MLAs' poll costs dismissed
items.text: The Court said it cannot order MLAs who resigned to repay election expenses, and imposed Rs 1 lakh costs.

items.caseName: State of Punjab v. Neelam
items.coram: Vinod S. Bhardwaj, Ravinder Malik, JJ.
items.headline: Death sentence for burying toddler alive commuted
items.text: The crime was heinous but not rarest of rare. The sentence became 30 years' rigorous imprisonment without remission.

items.caseName: Jaibir Singh v. Chaudhary Bansi Lal University
items.headline: Interview can't be a 'veto' without minimum marks
items.text: Where no qualifying marks were set for the interview, declaring a candidate unsuitable on it alone was a jurisdictional overreach.

items.caseName: Vinita Pooniya v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: One absent voter can't stall Khatushyamji civic poll
items.text: A single voter's absence is not a ground to postpone polling or order a re-poll. Schedules must hold barring riots or calamities.

items.caseName: M. Uday Krishna Reddy v. State of Telangana
items.headline: No routine potency test where digital penetration is alleged
items.text: The order for a potency test was set aside, as the prosecution did not show its relevance to the allegations.

items.caseName: Chief Judicial Magistrate v. Najeeb Kanthapuram
items.court: Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Manjeri, Kerala
items.headline: Contempt notice to MLA for obstructing advocate commissioner
items.text: The CJM issued a show-cause notice to the Perinthalmanna MLA over obstruction of property possession proceedings. Reply due in 7 working days.

items.caseName: Sachin Hindurao Waze v. National Investigation Agency
items.headline: Bail for Sachin Waze in Antilia bomb scare case
items.text: The court found no concrete evidence that terror was created and faulted the NIA for never recording the Ambani family's statements.
